title: Cosmological coupled black holes immersed in dark sector
summary: Motivated by theoretical and observational developments of cosmological coupled black holes, we construct an exact analytical solution for a black hole immersed in an anisotropic dark sector background, adopting the framework established by [Cadoni et al., JCAP 03 (2024) 026]. By generalizing a static seed metric to a dynamical FLRW background, we derive a solution where the black hole mass co-evolves with the cosmic expansion.
